coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study (EARLY_PHASE1). Only agents are PET radiotracers and MRI contrast; no therapeutic agent. Gadovist is not a registered intervention but the arm description says every subject receives it, so listed as diagnostic_agent. Eligibility says 'recurrent malignant brain tumors' and the detailed description says high grade gliomas, but glioblastoma is the only registered condition, so coded gbm_only.
